ValidationRule.description: Only SysAdmin, Carmen, Babita and Alex Gardner can change/edit relationship manager field on Travel accounts. SAL-4047 SAL-4613: Added Henry Kessker
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Profile.Name <> 'System Administrator', $User.User_LongID__c <> '0058W00000ErGiZQAV', /*carmen*/ $User.User_LongID__c <> '0058W00000EVTGWQA5', /*babita*/ $User.User_LongID__c <> '005f2000009yzvoAAA',/*alex*/ $User.User_LongID__c <> '0058W00000GK9zwQAD',/*henry*/ RecordType.Name = 'Travel', AND( ISPICKVAL( Account_Status__c , "Active (Product Live)"), ISCHANGED(Relationship_Manager__c), NOT( ISBLANK( PRIORVALUE(Relationship_Manager__c))))) && Acc_Val_Bypass__c = false
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please contact your manager to request a change of Relationship Manager for this account.
